newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan copper cable/wire shipments slip in August.
newsitem.headline: Japan copper cable/wire shipments slip in August.

text.p: Japan's shipments of copper cable and wire in August fell a marginal 0.7 percent from the same period last year to 77,300 tonnes, the Japanese Electric Wire and Cable Makers' Association said on Friday.
Domestic shipments rose a modest 1.3 percent to 74,300 tonnes, as gains in the automobile and construction sectors more than offset declines in the electric equipment and electric power sectors.
The domestic gains were countered, however, by a sharp year-on-year drop in exports of 32.4 percent to 3,000 tonnes.
August copper cable and wire orders fell a more marked 5.1 percent year-on-year to 79,600 tonnes, reflecting a sharp drop in orders from the electric power sector.
August aluminium wire and cable shipments fell 34.7 percent year-on-year to 4,000 tonnes while orders were up 171.2 percent at 10,300 tonnes, reflecting fluctuations in the electric power sector.
